name: Telos Consilium TelosC Surge

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

narrative.summary: One 2-of-5 Gnosis Safe is both owner and curator of this ~$100M USDT0 EulerEarn vault, no guardian is set, and the owner address also passes every curator, allocator and guardian check. Its owner-only calls (setCurator, setIsAllocator, setFee, setFeeRecipient) take effect immediately, outside the vault’s 1-day timelock.
narrative.detail: In the euler-earn source the 1-day delay covers only raising a market’s supply cap, removing a market, lowering the timelock and replacing an existing guardian, so timelockScore is 0: this project scores the gap, not the mere presence of a delay. crossExposureScore of 100 means no overlap was found among the addresses this repository names (an address search, not a full cross-chain comparison).

steps.what: owner() on the contract: the holder
getOwners() on the holder: the signer set (word 2 is the count)
getModulesPaginated(0x1, 50) on the holder: the modules (a module executes without the signatures)
the guard slot of the holder (keccak of guard_manager.guard.address)

cheapest_fix.what: a stronger admin setup (admin power spread beyond one key, or checked by others)

main_gap.requirement: Admin power is not a bare key
main_gap.reason: One key, or a tiny group, can change it

independent_read.disagree: the timelock score says no delay (0), the contract enforces its own timelock of 24 h (timelock())
independent_read.posture: admin: Safe 2-of-5 of 5 plain keys; delay: 24 h the contract enforces itself
